rule: Every brew is a bet. A tonic has a base effect that always lands and a JACKPOT effect that lands with probability p. Combining two herbs multiplies their odds (parlay): p = pA * pB, but the jackpot payout scales by 1/p (fair odds, no house edge). Brewing in a storm (Sky Director weather Storm) adds +0.1 to p: the Reaper favors the bold. Stormbloom may re-roll a failed jackpot once.

herbs.note: the safe bet; lowers parlay variance

herbs.jackpot: see the next drop/craft outcome before committing
